_comment: Probe definitions for tools/hwprobe/hwprobe.py. Canon RAM/ROM/MMIO addresses live ONLY here, each with the report that derived it. ML RAM addresses are written sym("name") and resolved from the .sym file given on the command line. Nothing here has been run on the camera: every 'expect' is a static-analysis prediction (M50 II fw 1.0.1).

stages.0: identity and safety (once, LiveView, before raw is enabled)
stages.2: after raw enable (reads only; operator enables raw, or --allow-call)
stages.3: during a recording attempt (rate-limited sampling loop, operator starts the recording)

enable_raw.operator_text: Enable raw now by the documented means (ML menu: raw video on, or load raw_vidx so that it calls raw_lv_request). Do not start recording.

calls.note: ML function; takes raw_sem and calls lv_set_mm/lv_save_raw. Not proven non-blocking from the serial shell task.

probes.title: Shell alive, build string
probes.decision: Stop if the shell does not answer; record the build string next to the .sym used.

probes.title: The .sym belongs to the running build (weak check: ml_started == 1)
probes.decision: FAIL = wrong .sym or ML not fully started; every sym() address in this run is then suspect.

checks.pass: ml_started reads 1 at the address the .sym gives
checks.fail: not 1: wrong .sym for this build, or boot did not reach big.8

probes.title: EvfState object identity at *(0x8E8C)
probes.decision: All PASS = the EvfState hook option (F1) may be tried. Any identity mismatch stops the EvfState option.

steps.else: *(0x8E8C) is 0: object not created (not in LiveView?)

checks.pass: name pointer is the ROM string "EvfState"
checks.fail: name pointer differs: *(0x8E8C) is not the EvfState object

checks.pass: dispatcher is the generic state-object dispatcher
checks.fail: dispatcher differs (already hooked, or wrong object)
state is not 5: not in LiveView, or the 3..6 window in F1 must be revisited

probes.title: EvfDevState object at *(0x10108)
probes.decision: Confirms which object the current hook (state 3) sits on.

steps.else: *(0x10108) is 0 (zero at boot per A15; LiveView not started?)

probes.title: EvfDev / EvfCap TaskClass priorities
probes.decision: Fixes the priority ceiling for ML copy/write tasks (A11, C9).

probes.title: Mem1Path baseline (ctx 0x10238, +0x40..+0x6f) before lv_save_raw
probes.decision: +0x50 = 0 means Mem1Path is inactive in this mode and lv_save_raw cannot deliver raw there.

checks.fail: flag already set: raw was enabled before this stage; stage-0 baseline is not a baseline
+0x50 = 0: Mem1Path inactive in this mode; look at +0x48 (word 2)

probes.title: Mem1Path completion-CBR slot 0x1029C
probes.decision: Anything other than 0xE06AD51B means something replaced Canon's channel-3 callback; also tells when the slot is valid for the F1 alternative-B trampoline.

checks.fail: slot replaced or not yet written

probes.title: Soft-assert sink 0x22D9C
probes.decision: +8 non-zero = LV asserts are routed to a non-fatal sink (explains repeating prints).

probes.title: RscWrap function table at 0x5128
probes.decision: A different slot 0/4 means the second init variant (0xE0041932) ran; the A8 pool analysis must be redone.

checks.pass: table matches the statically derived one

probes.title: RscMgr object pointer and AllocateMemory pool handle
probes.decision: Both must exist before any shoot-pool / SRM experiment.

probes.title: PropertyMgr object pointer *(0x4FF4)
probes.decision: 0 = PropertyMgr not created (the QEMU divergence); property calls would assert at PropertyMgr.c:484.

probes.title: DebugMsg context class levels and console gate
probes.decision: Byte ctx+0x39 <= 6 means the debug-message recursion in the pool-empty path is not bounded by level; 0x5158 non-zero = console live (gate open).

checks.pass: byte +0x39 is 6 (default; recursion unbounded per A3)

probes.title: CPU0 interrupt stack top [0x1014]
probes.decision: Confirms the faulting stack range 0xDF000000-0xDF001000 used by the pc=0 crash model.

checks.fail: interrupt stack top differs; the A3 overflow model needs the real range

probes.title: Event-container pool: control block and free count (host-side walk of a dump)
probes.decision: Free count close to 1536 at idle is the baseline; a count that falls during recording and does not return names the pool-exhaustion crash family (docs/42).

steps.else: pool init flag is 0: pool not built yet

checks.pass: free-list head points into the pool
free count within 136 of the full 1536
checks.fail: fewer than 1400 free containers (or walk broke, see evfree[1]); expected only while a receiver is stalled

probes.title: Word at address 0 (NULL-release fingerprint)
probes.decision: A value inside 0xBEE18-0xC4E18 means the pool releaser was once called with NULL: a pool-empty event happened and was survived.

checks.fail: pool pointer at address 0: NULL release happened

probes.title: Property-token records at 0x58278 and [0xA590]
probes.decision: A field equal to 0x32 (or any non-pointer) points at the module whose token variable is misused: the 0xE021B8FC EVF crash family.

probes.title: Default task stack size and maximum priority
probes.decision: Tells what stack 0 means for Canon tasks and the legal priority ceiling.

probes.title: debug_assert handler slot 0x4000
probes.decision: Must hold an ML address when ML's non-fatal assert handler is installed.

checks.pass: slot points into ML code (see nearest symbol)
checks.fail: slot does not point into ML: handler not installed

probes.title: GUI mode current/requested, LV overlay index, display-on flag
probes.decision: Run once per GUI state (label the run with --label) to fix GUIMODE_*, LV_OVERLAYS_MODE and DISPLAY_IS_ON polarity.

probes.title: Sensor drive mode, HEAD table base pointers, LvComPack handlers
probes.decision: Run once per video mode (--label): gives the Canon mode -> drive mode map and the handlers to disassemble for bit depth.

checks.pass: second HEAD table base is the ROM1 blob
checks.fail: base differs: table-A inference (A9-verify claim 1) is wrong

probes.title: Live MMU L1 entries for the raw buffer views
probes.decision: Confirms 0x6BC/0x463 are non-cacheable and 0x2BC cacheable in the LIVE table; FAIL may only mean patch_mmu swapped tables (read TTBR-relative then).

probes.title: PL310 outer cache ID / control
probes.decision: Informational: confirms the outer cache controller guess.

probes.title: HEAD timers A/B and channel-3 size register
probes.decision: Per video mode (--label): fps x (A+1) x (B+1) ~ 27.0e6 confirms TG_FREQ_BASE; 0xD0420250 low16 = bytes/line, high16 = lines-1 (0x048B0E54 expected in 1080p) reveals bit depth.

checks.pass: timer A is one of the three table values

probes.title: EDMAC channel 3 live registers; channel 13 mux
probes.decision: Shows what +4/+8/+0xB4 look like on a running write channel, and that channel 13 is unconnected (0) before any ML mem2mem attempt.

checks.fail: channel 13 mux already non-zero: a select without disconnect would assert BoomerSelector 0x10C

probes.title: EvfState / EvfDevState current state
probes.decision: EvfState must stay 5 and EvfDevState 3; a value that changes means the hook's state window must be revisited.

probes.title: MvRawProDs / RawPro 2-slot ring counts
probes.decision: Count 2 at idle = pipeline already degraded, recording will storm. Count reaching 2 only while ML copies = the copy starves Canon's EDMAC completions (hypothesis a).

probes.title: LvJob pool: six slot flags (non-zero = free)
probes.decision: All six zero in one sample = LvJob.c L:D5 imminent.

checks.pass: at least one LvJob slot free

probes.title: Event-pool free-list head (cheap level indicator)
probes.decision: Head 0 = pool empty (crash imminent). The exact level needs F4.1; a head that stops changing while LV runs is also informative.

probes.title: Panel YUV buffer pointer *(0xAB10)+0xB0
probes.decision: Three rotating values 0x3F4800 apart give YUV422_LV_BUFFER_1..3 (see 'distinct' in the result).

probes.title: RawPro context 0x292B0: mode and the two EDMAC channels
probes.decision: Words +0x30 / +0x34 are the channels ML must never touch. C9 stop rule: re-plan if either reads 3 (Mem1Path's own channel).

checks.fail: channel A is 3: C9 stop rule

checks.pass: RawPro channel B is not 3 (0x29 expected)
checks.fail: channel B is 3: C9 stop rule

probes.title: CPU0 interrupt stack floor: untouched 0xEEEEEEEE fill
probes.decision: The count of leading fill words is the high-water margin; 0 = the stack reached its floor (overflow model of the pc=0 crashes).

checks.pass: fill pattern intact at the floor
checks.fail: floor word overwritten: interrupt stack has been exhausted at least once this boot

probes.title: Pending messages on the EvfDev and EvfCap queues (CALL 0xE05BA079)
probes.decision: Near 0 = healthy. Climbing toward 200 during recording = the hook body stalls that task.

probes.title: Mem1Path after raw enable: flag, supplied buffer, armed
probes.decision: +0x58 non-zero and +0x60 = 1: the LV core supplies param[8] and channel 3 is armed, raw comes through Mem1Path. +0x58 = 0: no buffer supplied, the raw path is NOT Mem1Path; stop and re-plan (C9).

checks.fail: flag still 0: raw was not enabled
0x10290 differs from raw_info.buffer: ML reads a different buffer than Canon writes

probes.title: Cached vs uncached view of the live raw buffer, 1 s apart
probes.decision: Uncached view must change between reads (frames arriving). A cached view that differs from the uncached one proves stale cache lines: any cacheable read path needs an invalidate first.

checks.pass: uncached view changed: frames are arriving
checks.fail: uncached view identical after 1 s: buffer not being written (or a static dark scene; point at something moving)
cached view is stale relative to uncached (expected per A13)

probes.title: Channel-3 EDMAC address register 0xD04202A0
probes.decision: Must equal raw_info.buffer (0x6BC61CC8 in one earlier 1080p session; moves per boot/mode).

not_automated.why: writes a word into the Mem1Path CBR slot and needs a staged trampoline (load/exec)
statespy hooks the state object (a write) and F1.4 needs the offline-evfstate-1 core build
writes 0 to 0x5158 and provokes the crash
abort-handler changes: a core rebuild, not a serial probe
calls into EDMAC select/disconnect and reads 0xD044xxxx, which is not known to be awake
allocation calls that block forever from the shell (docs/32:1141); need a module task
MMIO writes to the HEAD timers; DNG column statistics on the host
task-list walk and A/B recordings need module code
calls (resource locks, dm levels, display off, RTC) or disassembly of RAM blobs
need module/core builds; F1.9's assert counting is covered by the stage-3 UART log tally
in-use histogram needs marking in module code; A/B recordings
